project.title: Doc to Table
project.aim: Flexible .doc/.docx tables on GitHub Pages: headers and data picked independently, records combined, blocks joined. Original bytes and source evidence are the ground truth; anything not fully structured stays source-linked and inspectable. No zero-error claim; no required backend; no silent source loss. (Owner confirmed Oracle O1's read-back, 22 Oct.)

M1.name: Evidence and contracts
M1.full: Source hashes, scope, frozen denominators, Pages constraints and required evidence are explicit.

M2.name: Preservation and inventory
M2.full: Original bytes, independent package entries, controls, nesting and geometry are retained; failures stay visible.
M2.canDo: No qualified browser custody/inventory prototype yet

M3.name: Source and exceptions
M3.full: Raw remainders and unsupported objects open exact evidence; rendering failure leaves source-grid review usable.

M4.name: Flexible mapping
M4.full: Independent headers/data, joins, selected-row combinations, contexts and matrices preserve field lineage.

M5.name: Validation and exports
M5.full: Declared native browser flow, fixed checks/reviews and portable source-linked evidence meet exact candidate requirements.

M6.name: Legacy DOC
M6.full: Browser-compatible import/normalization is qualified against retained original .doc sources.

M7.name: Templates and assistance
M7.full: Suggestions and template mismatches remain proposals and cannot bypass source/evidence gates.
